heroSummary: Seminole County publishes an ordered Inclement-Weather Make-Up plan: January 5, March 13, December 19, then May 28. The first three are otherwise student holidays or teacher workdays around grading-period transitions.
seoTitle: Seminole County School Calendar 2025-2026 | Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: Seminole County Public Schools calendar 2025-2026 with first day, last day, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, holidays, PDF and ICS.
calendarNotes: Seminole County Public Schools starts the 2025-2026 school year on August 11, 2025 and lists May 27, 2026 as the last day of school. Thanksgiving Break runs November 24-28, Winter Break runs December 22-January 2, and Spring Break runs March 16-20. The calendar lists teacher workdays or student holidays on October 13, December 19, January 5, and March 13, which are important no-school dates for childcare planning. SCPS also publishes an inclement-weather make-up day order: January 5, March 13, December 19, and May 28.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Seminole County start school in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Seminole County Public Schools starts the 2025-2026 school year on Monday, August 11, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Seminole County Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 16 through Friday, March 20, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Seminole County in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school on the SCPS 2025-2026 student attendance calendar is Wednesday, May 27, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Which SCPS 2025-2026 dates are listed as make-up days?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar lists make-up days in this order: January 5, 2026; March 13, 2026; December 19, 2025; and May 28, 2026.
